D1_case.sql:
WITH Stage1 AS (
SELECT n0.node_id AS n, CASE WHEN (p2.val = 'i' OR p3.val = 'f') THEN p4.val ELSE p5.val END AS x, n0.graph_id AS __g_n
FROM Graph_KG.nodes n0
JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_labels l1 ON l1.s = n0.node_id AND l1.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND l1.label = ?
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p2 ON p2.s = n0.node_id AND p2.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND p2."key" = ?
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p3 ON p3.s = n0.node_id AND p3.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND p3."key" = ?
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p4 ON p4.s = n0.node_id AND p4.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND p4."key" = ?
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p5 ON p5.s = n0.node_id AND p5.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND p5."key" = ?
WHERE l1.s IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT Graph_KG.CY_TYPED(n) AS "id", x AS x
FROM Stage1
ORDER BY %EXACT(Graph_KG.CY_SORT_KEY(n, 'x')) ASC

D1_coalesce.sql:

D2_collect.sql:
SELECT Graph_KG.CY_TYPED(n0.node_id) AS "id", COALESCE(JSON_ARRAYAGG('{"_id":"' || n2.node_id || '",' || '"_labels":' || COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(label) FROM Graph_KG.rdf_labels WHERE s = n2.node_id AND graph_id = n2.graph_id), CAST('[]' AS VARCHAR(256))) || ',' || '"_props":' || COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG('{"key":"' || REPLACE(REPLACE("key", '\', '\\'), '"', '\"') || '","value":' || CASE WHEN val IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN Graph_KG.CY_JSON_NUM(val) IS NOT NULL THEN Graph_KG.CY_JSON_NUM(val) WHEN val = 'true' OR val = 'false' THEN val WHEN val = '' THEN '""' ELSE COALESCE(Graph_KG.CY_JSON_LISTMAP(val), TRIM(TRAILING ']' FROM SUBSTRING(JSON_ARRAY(val), 2))) END END || '}') FROM Graph_KG.rdf_props WHERE s = n2.node_id AND graph_id = n2.graph_id), '[]') || ',"_graph":"' || REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(n2.graph_id, ''), '\', '\\'), '"', '\"') || '"' || '}'), CAST('[]' AS VARCHAR(256))) AS bs
FROM Graph_KG.nodes n0
JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_labels l1 ON l1.s = n0.node_id AND l1.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND l1.label = ?
LEFT OUTER JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_edges e3 ON e3.s = n0.node_id AND e3.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND e3.p = ?
LEFT OUTER JOIN Graph_KG.nodes n2 ON n2.node_id = e3.o_id AND n2.graph_id = e3.graph_id
WHERE l1.s IS NOT NULL AND n0.node_id = CAST('i58d_080853_i' AS VARCHAR(256))
GROUP BY n0.node_id

D2_opt.sql:

FROM Graph_KG.nodes n0
JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_labels l1 ON l1.s = n0.node_id AND l1.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND l1.label = ?
LEFT OUTER JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_edges e3 ON e3.s = n0.node_id AND e3.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND e3.p = ?
LEFT OUTER JOIN Graph_KG.nodes n2 ON n2.node_id = e3.o_id AND n2.graph_id = e3.graph_id
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p4 ON p4.s = n2.node_id AND p4.graph_id = n2.graph_id AND p4."key" = ?
WHERE l1.s IS NOT NULL AND n0.node_id = CAST('i58d_080853_i' AS VARCHAR(256))

WHERE l1.s IS NOT NULL AND n0.node_id = CAST('i58d_080853_i' AS VARCHAR(256))
)
SELECT Graph_KG.CY_TYPED(a) AS "id", b AS b_id, COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(label) FROM Graph_KG.rdf_labels WHERE s = b AND graph_id = Stage1.__g_b), CAST('[]' AS VARCHAR(256))) AS b_labels, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG('{"key":"' || REPLACE(REPLACE("key", '\', '\\'), '"', '\"') || '","value":' || CASE WHEN val IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN Graph_KG.CY_JSON_NUM(val) IS NOT NULL THEN Graph_KG.CY_JSON_NUM(val) WHEN val = 'true' OR val = 'false' THEN val WHEN val = '' THEN '""' ELSE COALESCE(Graph_KG.CY_JSON_LISTMAP(val), TRIM(TRAILING ']' FROM SUBSTRING(JSON_ARRAY(val), 2))) END END || '}') FROM Graph_KG.rdf_props WHERE s = b AND graph_id = Stage1.__g_b) AS b_props, Graph_KG.CY_TYPED(%EXACT(p4.val)) AS bx
FROM Stage1
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p4 ON p4.s = b AND p4.graph_id = Stage1.__g_b AND p4."key" = ?

SELECT Graph_KG.CY_TYPED(Graph_KG.CY_ARITH(%EXACT(p2.val), '+', 1)) AS a, Graph_KG.CY_TYPED(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(%EXACT(p3.val) AS VARCHAR(3641144)), 1, 1) = 'P' THEN Graph_KG.CY_TEMPORAL_ARITH(%EXACT(p3.val), '*', CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE)) ELSE (CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(%EXACT(p3.val)) = 0 THEN CAST(Graph_KG.CypherFn_IVGTYPEERROR('TypeError: InvalidArgumentType: * needs two numbers and got a value that is not one' || COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST(%EXACT(p3.val) AS VARCHAR(64)), 1, 0), '') || COALESCE(SUBSTRING(CAST(CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE) AS VARCHAR(64)), 1, 0), '')) AS DOUBLE) ELSE CAST(%EXACT(p3.val) AS DOUBLE) END * CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE)) END) AS b, Graph_KG.CY_TYPED(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(CAST(%EXACT(p4.val) AS VARCHAR(3641144)), 1, 1) = 'P' THEN Graph_KG.CY_TEMPORAL_ARITH(%EXACT(p4.val), '/', 2) ELSE Graph_KG.CY_ARITH(%EXACT(p4.val), '/', 2) END) AS c

D6_bool.sql:
SELECT Graph_KG.CY_TYPED(n0.node_id) AS "id", CASE WHEN ((CASE WHEN (ASCII($LISTBUILD(%EXACT(%EXACT(p3.val)))) > 0 AND ASCII(SUBSTRING($LISTBUILD(%EXACT(%EXACT(p3.val))), 2, 1)) BETWEEN 4 AND 9) THEN CAST(%EXACT(p3.val) AS DOUBLE) WHEN %EXACT(%EXACT(p3.val)) IN ('Infinity', 'inf', '-Infinity', '-inf') THEN CAST(%EXACT(p3.val) AS DOUBLE) END) > 2.7) THEN 1 WHEN NOT ((CASE WHEN (ASCII($LISTBUILD(%EXACT(%EXACT(p3.val)))) > 0 AND ASCII(SUBSTRING($LISTBUILD(%EXACT(%EXACT(p3.val))), 2, 1)) BETWEEN 4 AND 9) THEN CAST(%EXACT(p3.val) AS DOUBLE) WHEN %EXACT(%EXACT(p3.val)) IN ('Infinity', 'inf', '-Infinity', '-inf') THEN CAST(%EXACT(p3.val) AS DOUBLE) END) > 2.7) THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS b
FROM Graph_KG.nodes n0
JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_labels l1 ON l1.s = n0.node_id AND l1.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND l1.label = ?
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p2 ON p2.s = n0.node_id AND p2.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND p2."key" = ?
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p3 ON p3.s = n0.node_id AND p3.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND p3."key" = ?

queries.D1_case: MATCH (n:I58DL080853) WITH n, CASE WHEN n.k = 'i' OR n.k = 'f' THEN n.v ELSE n.s END AS x RETURN n.node_id AS id, x ORDER BY n.node_id
queries.D1_case_noid: MATCH (n:I58DL080853) WITH CASE WHEN n.k = 'i' OR n.k = 'f' THEN n.v ELSE n.s END AS x RETURN x ORDER BY toString(x)
queries.D1_coalesce: MATCH (n:I58DL080853) WITH n, coalesce(n.v, n.s) AS x RETURN n.node_id AS id, x ORDER BY n.node_id
queries.D1_ret_case: MATCH (n:I58DL080853) RETURN n.node_id AS id, CASE WHEN n.k = 'i' OR n.k = 'f' THEN n.v ELSE n.s END AS x ORDER BY n.node_id
queries.D2_collect: MATCH (a:I58DL080853 {node_id: 'i58d_080853_i'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:I58NONE]->(b) RETURN a.node_id AS id, collect(b) AS bs
queries.D2_opt: MATCH (a:I58DL080853 {node_id: 'i58d_080853_i'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:I58NONE]->(b) RETURN a.node_id AS id, b, b.x AS bx
queries.D2_with: MATCH (a:I58DL080853 {node_id: 'i58d_080853_i'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:I58NONE]->(b) WITH a, b RETURN a.node_id AS id, b, b.x AS bx
queries.D3_empty: MATCH (n:I58DL080853 {node_id: 'i58d_080853_i'}) RETURN n.e AS e, n.el AS el, n.em AS em
queries.D3_empty_with: MATCH (n:I58DL080853 {node_id: 'i58d_080853_i'}) WITH n.e AS e, n.el AS el RETURN e, el
queries.D4_map: MATCH (n:I58DL080853 {node_id: 'i58d_080853_i'}) RETURN {a: n.v, b: 'x'} AS m
queries.D4_map_nested: MATCH (n:I58DL080853 {node_id: 'i58d_080853_i'}) RETURN {a: [1, n.v], t: true, s: n.s} AS m
queries.D5_float: MATCH (n:I58DL080853W) RETURN n.v + 1 AS a, n.v * 1.5 AS b, n.v / 2 AS c
queries.D5_int: MATCH (n:I58DL080853 {node_id: 'i58d_080853_i'}) RETURN n.v + 1 AS a, n.v * 1.5 AS b, n.v / 2 AS c
queries.D6_bool: MATCH (n:I58DL080853) WHERE n.k IN ['i', 'f', 's'] RETURN n.node_id AS id, n.v > 2.7 AS b ORDER BY n.node_id
queries.D7_empty: MATCH (a:I58DL080853 {node_id: 'nope'})-[:I58DK080853]->(b) RETURN a.node_id AS id, b.x AS bx
queries.D8_read: MATCH (n:I58DL080853) RETURN n.node_id AS id, n.v AS v, n.s AS s ORDER BY n.node_id
queries.D9_all: MATCH (a {node_id: 'i58d_080853_i'})-[:I58DK080853*1..3]->(b) RETURN b.node_id AS id ORDER BY id
queries.D9_limit: MATCH (a {node_id: 'i58d_080853_i'})-[:I58DK080853*1..3]->(b) RETURN b.node_id AS id LIMIT 2
queries.D9_order_limit: MATCH (a {node_id: 'i58d_080853_i'})-[:I58DK080853*1..3]->(b) RETURN b.node_id AS id ORDER BY id LIMIT 2
